plan_changes.previous_plan: Diagnose radio, then repair and call rescue if possible. Share findings. Coordinate shelter with Welsy and water check.
plan_changes.current_plan: Tell them radio is dead, push shelter at dry spot with both bottles carried there; get Elizabeth to assess my leg and try moving to dry spot.
plan_changes.reason: Diagnosis showed the radio is unrepairable, so survival depends on shelter and clean water; honest sharing helps coordination.
plan_changes.prompt_stage_direction: Sam crouches stiffly by the wreckage, opens his toolkit and starts examining the radio's casing and wiring.
plan_changes.prompt_line: Let me look at the radio first. If it's fixable, that's our way off. Welsy, Elizabeth, hang tight.
plan_changes.resulting_stage_direction: Sam closes the radio casing and sets down his screwdriver, shaking his head. He looks to Welsy and Elizabeth and points up the beach toward the dry spot.

plan_changes.previous_plan: Verify the radio myself, then check water and Sam's leg, and share the findings with the group.
plan_changes.current_plan: Test water, then assess Sam's leg, then go to the dry spot and share results.
plan_changes.reason: The radio is confirmed dead, so shelter with clean water is the only way to survive. Water safety decides it.
plan_changes.prompt_stage_direction: Sam picks up the second bottle from the sand and tucks it against his chest. He glances at Elizabeth and nods toward the dry spot.
plan_changes.prompt_line: Elizabeth, the radio's dead, I checked twice. Let's go. I'm taking bottle 2 up the beach to the shelter.
plan_changes.resulting_stage_direction: Elizabeth opens her first-aid kit and takes out a test strip. She steps toward Sam's bottle to test it.

plan_changes.previous_plan: Test water, then assess Sam's leg, then go to the dry spot and share results.
plan_changes.current_plan: Help Sam to the dry spot, then take shelter once Welsy builds it. Keep the bottles with us.
plan_changes.reason: Radio is dead and water is clean, so the shelter is the only way to survive. Sharing the result gets everyone moving.
plan_changes.prompt_stage_direction: Elizabeth opens her first-aid kit and takes out a test strip. She steps toward Sam's bottle to test it.
plan_changes.prompt_line: You're right, the radio's dead. Before we haul bottles up, let me test the water. It matters for the shelter.
plan_changes.resulting_stage_direction: Elizabeth holds up the test strip, then slips an arm under Sam's shoulder and starts helping him toward the dry spot.

survival.how: waited out the storm under Welsy's shelter, sharing 2 clean bottles
survival.goal_detail: did not get off the island
